annotator_notes:
S2b of E08-016. Reviewer-confirmed 2026-09-20. ENTERS §9.1's in-force denominator -- shared_subject_split is ANNOTATION_CONVENTION under §8.10, which admits.

THE GOLD SET'S FIRST FULLY COMPILABLE `WITHIN`, VERIFIED BY EXECUTION RATHER THAN ASSUMED. _classify_temporal('within 30 days of KIRKLAND'S's receipt of NFI's invoice') returns WITHIN 30d OF "KIRKLAND'S's receipt of NFI's invoice". The preposition is 'of', which _WITHIN_RE accepts, so §8.6's within_preposition does NOT apply; the numeral is bare, so §8's parenthetical-numeral gap does not apply either. §8.6.1 records that the set carries exactly two WITHIN temporals, C17-02 and C11-03, and BOTH are tagged within_preposition -- this is the first untagged one, which is worth noting because §8.6.1's own v0.55 closing note frames the WITHIN form as having been effectively absent from gold by rule until v0.52. unit is the AST's 'd', not the document's 'days' (clause 6 compares canonical forms -- C17-02's restamp note).

MISSING_FIELDS ['temporal.of'] -- the WithinTemporal branch's REAL path, not 'temporal.trigger'. C11-03 is the precedent. §3.9 trigger 3 fires regardless since symbols.resolve_trigger() returns None throughout v1, so underspecified is true even though both parties are named and resolvable.

SPAN IS §8.3.1's OPTION 4. 'shall provide NFI with...' alone leaves the obligor KIRKLAND'S -- at the head of S2, shared with S2a -- OUTSIDE span_text, which is NESTED_FIELD_NOT_IN_SPAN, the v0.31 amendment's unreachable option 3. So the span runs from the shared subject through the end of its own verb phrase and contains S2a. NESTING IS FAR BELOW §4.1's THRESHOLD, computed not assumed: E08-04 [81:144] inside this [81:295] gives IoU 63/214 = 0.2944. Only this item carries shared_subject_split, matching C14-02's treatment (the EXTENDED item carries it; the minimal sibling does not).

TWO ITEMS, NOT ONE, under §4.3: disputing only in good faith and giving notice of the basis are INDEPENDENTLY BREACHABLE -- KIRKLAND'S can dispute in bad faith yet give notice, or dispute in good faith and give none. Separate performances, so §8.3's one-indivisible-performance branch does not apply and no compound_action tag is owed.

'notice' AS HEAD NOUN IS §3.6.2's COGNATE-OBJECT RESIDUE, CLEARED BY CARVE-OUT 1. NOTIFY sits in the action_accept_set and §3.6.2 reads restatement against the WHOLE set, so the label does restate an accept-set verb -- but the span says 'written NOTICE', the document's own word for the thing, twice-over the C22-01 pattern. §3.6's v0.58 head-only rule carries an explicit exemption pointing at exactly this case.

CONDITIONS EMPTY. 'in reasonable good faith' is in-span (option 4 pulls S2a in) but is a REVIEWABLE-STANDARD phrase, excluded from conditions by §3.8's v0.54 rule (C04-06's 'acting reasonably'), and it gates S2a's duty rather than this one in any event. 'of the basis for disputing any amounts on an invoice' is object scope.

§8.4.2 DOES NOT FIRE: test (b) fails -- the obligor is a single named party, not a collective or distributive reference, so the obligation does not bind two or more parties.
segment_text: KIRKLAND’S shall pay all undisputed amounts invoiced as provided in Section 6.2. KIRKLAND’S shall only dispute amounts in reasonable good faith and shall provide NFI with written notice of the basis for disputing any amounts on an invoice within 30 days of KIRKLAND’S’s receipt of NFI’s invoice. Payments not received by NFI within fifteen (15) days of KIRKLAND’S’s receipt of written notice that such payment is overdue will be subject to a service charge of 1% per month on the unpaid balance.
